newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich CFO Haenggi to resign mid-1997. [CORRECTED 10:48 GMT 28/9]
newsitem.headline: Zurich CFO Haenggi to resign mid-1997. [CORRECTED 10:48 GMT 28/9]

text.p: Rolf Haenggi, chief financial officer of Zurich Insurance Co. since 1987, will resign his position from mid-1997 in order to have more time to sit on the boards of other companies, Zurich Insurance's chief executive and chairman said. (Corrects to make clear that Haenggi will not carry out tasks that are assigned by Zurich's board.)
"He will make himself independent, so to speak," Rolf Hueppi told a news conference, adding he deeply regretted Haenggi's decision.
While Haenggi will not stand for reelection as a member of Zurich's board of directors, Hueppi said he hoped he would continue as chairman of the board of bank Rued, Blass & Cie..
A successor to Haenggi has not yet been chosen.
